history.period: Modern (20th-21st century; exact founding date unverified)
history.summary: The Hanuman Temple of Dimapur most documented on the web is the Shree Hanuman Mandir at Lahorijan, on the Dimapur-Diphu road near the Assam border, managed by the Shri Hanumanji Temple Trust (Regd.), Dimapur (797112). It is a colourfully decorated modern shrine with a large standing Hanuman murti; no reliable source gives a founding date or dynasty (UNVERIFIED). IDENTITY CAVEAT (verify): the CSV name 'Hanuman Temple, Dimapur' is generic; at least two Hanuman shrines are listed in Dimapur (Lahorijan and West Yard Colony, Railway Colony) and this file follows the Lahorijan temple as the most documented one.

name: Shree Hanuman Mandir, Lahorijan
town_description: Lahorijan is a settlement on the Assam-Nagaland border along the Dimapur-Diphu road, administratively in Dimapur district. It sits at the edge of the Naga Hills foothills where the plains meet the hills, serving as a transit point between Dimapur city and Karbi Anglong (Assam). The CSV town 'Dimapur' is approximate: the temple is at Lahorijan, roughly 10-15 km from central Dimapur (verify).

travel.road: On the Dimapur-Diphu road near Lahorijan; reachable by taxi/auto-rickshaw from Dimapur (verify)

visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-1:00 PM and 3:00 PM-9:00 PM daily (per the Trust's listed page; verify)
